summary: Backend-only regression pass for Smart Home Finance API. Executed 14 pytest cases against the EXTERNAL URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). All 14 tests PASSED (100%). Coverage: auth (register/login/me + negative cases), transactions (CRUD + type filter), bills (create → toggle to lunas → delete), savings (CRUD), shopping (create/delete), education (child + items + cascade delete), dashboard summary (all 6-month cashflow + expense_by_category + upcoming_bills + savings + health_score), and AI insight (LLM path verified — returns rich Bahasa Indonesia analysis, e.g. 'Bulan September 2026, pemasukan Rp10.000.000 dan pengeluaran Rp7.000.000 ...'). Empty-data path also returns the correct Indonesian fallback message. No backend bugs found.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased on server; response returns lowercased email while client submitted mixed-case. Not a bug per se, but frontend should be aware when displaying user profile.

Duplicate-email path relies on the unique index created at startup, but the pre-check (find_one) returns 400 first. If two concurrent registrations race, one will bubble a 500 from the Mongo duplicate-key exception. Not blocking for MVP.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Optionally wrap register in try/except to convert Mongo DuplicateKeyError into a clean 400 to close the race-condition window.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 578-line file. Still readable, but if more resources are added, split into routers/ (auth, transactions, bills, savings, shopping, education, dashboard, insights).
Duplicate 'delete → return {ok: True}' and PUT patterns across 5 resources are prime candidates for a generic CRUD helper.
Emergent LLM key is hardcoded in backend/.env (expected for this platform); dashboard/insight endpoints correctly gate on Bearer auth.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers a fresh TEST_<uuid>@example.com user for isolation; no shared/seeded data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tests are self-contained (fresh user per session). pytest-xdist LoadScopeScheduling is enabled — do NOT rely on cross-class data (each class gets its own fixture on its worker). Dashboard test seeds its own transactions for that reason.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures after test corrections. The 3 initial failures in the first run were test-script issues (email case-sensitive compare and pytest-xdist splitting fixtures across workers), not backend bugs. Fixed both in backend_test.py; final run is 14/14 green.
